column1: # Remote ATV 6.1.0 build 45; optional D-pad hold tolerance after swipe lock.
# Suppresses movement-only cancellation before and after gesture acceptance,
# only for started, active arrow holds in both repeat modes under a Px D-pad.
# Center/select, other controls, initial taps and release/cancel handlers stay intact.
# No allocation/call in the hook; return zero from the shared distance check for those holds.
